summary: Frontend-only bug-fix verification for timer-based crossfade auto-advance on Hot Live 95. PRIMARY TEST PASSED: With license bypassed, created playlist TEST_AutoAdv, added 3x6s WAV tones (220/440/330) via add-files-input, clicked play on PlayerBar and observed foreground auto-advance for ~22s with NO manual clicks. Observed track sequence: Tone 220 Long -> Tone 440 Long -> Tone 330 Long (2 automatic advances, matching ~3s crossfade handoff around 6-9s/9-10.5s timeline). Row 3 highlights at end and player holds last track (end-of-playlist, expected). Regression PASSED: manual next advances 220->440, prev returns to 220, play/pause toggles correctly, app-logo renders, 0 console errors / 0 page errors / 0 warnings across both runs. No stuck fade or stalled playback observed.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js remains >3000 lines (per iter 42) - still should be split into focused hooks/modules.

The now-playing active-track-row highlight in TrackList is visually present (orange text + play icon on row 3) but exposes no stable aria/data-active attribute - testing agents must rely on className regex. Consider adding data-active='true' on the currently playing track-row for robust automation.

Dismiss 'Maybe later' install prompt. Create playlist via new-playlist-button -> new-playlist-input -> confirm-create-playlist. The add-files-input is HIDDEN so use wait_for_selector(..., state='attached') then set_input_files. Default settings autoplay=on (Auto fire-orange highlighted), crossfade=on (Xfade amber highlighted), crossfade-seconds=3. Click play-pause-button and poll player-track-name every 2s. Expected transition timeline for 6s tracks + 3s xfade: track1 0-6s, handoff to track2 at ~3s, track2 fully audible by ~6s playing until ~9s, handoff to track3 at ~6s, etc. Observed: 220 at T+1.5-5.5s, 440 at T+7.5s, 330 at T+9.5s onward.
